Progress over cumulative experiments, per evidence class. A step is a new best net CAGR among records with max drawdown within 30%: a constraint, not a blended score. **Development steps are partly hindsight** and rise with the number of trials tried; only a rising sealed-forward, shadow, paper or live curve is evidence of learning. A flat curve with many experiments is a finding, not a failure to record.
